predictive_services_discussion: Moderate to high-risk significant fire potential is forecast across the southern Plains and extending into Oklahoma, Arkansas and Mississippi today with highs reaching 100°F, RH 25-30% and locally breezy winds. Moderate to high-risk conditions continue across parts of Wyoming and southeastern Montana due to continued dry and breezy winds. Across the remainder of the west gradual warming and drying will bring some areas into the low-risk category, especially across central and northern California and Nevada.
